title: Exploring non-invasive biomarkers for pulmonary nodule detection based on salivary microbiomics and machine learning algorithms.
summary: In a 193-person multicenter case-control cohort (153 pulmonary nodules, 40 controls), salivary microbiome features plus ML discriminate PN/control and identify candidate taxa/features; comparison to matched clinical characteristics and held-out model test are reported. This is a measured, retrospective diagnostic association, not a screening or clinical-utility claim.
